about: Archived series: published records that are checked against their own commit, not against the tree at hand (DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-23). To check one, take the public repository at public_commit and run lab/tools/verify-build.sh there. An entry with "paths" archives only its commit's records under those prefixes of records/; the commit's other records are held against the tree as before (method version 3, DECISIONS 2026-11-26).
